description: BPSC TRE 2.0 Computer Science question paper containing Part-I Language, Part-II General Studies, and Part-III Computer Science.

questions.questionText: In this school, all _______ students are given free education.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The definite article 'the' is used after 'all' when referring to a specific group of students within a particular school.

questions.questionText: I have a friend in Mumbai who is _______ actress.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The indefinite article 'an' precedes words beginning with a vowel sound, such as 'actress'.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a river?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Bay of Bengal is a large body of sea water, whereas the Ganga and Godavari are rivers.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a part of drawing room?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Both a washing machine and a kitchen chimney are not typically parts of a drawing room, making 'More than one of the above' correct.

questions.questionText: Today is Sunday. The day before yesterday was
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: If today is Sunday, yesterday was Saturday, and the day before yesterday was Friday.

questions.questionText: November comes after the month of
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: November comes immediately after October. Since October is not listed among the options, 'None of the above' is correct.

questions.questionText: Husband's brother is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A spouse's brother is defined in kinship terms as a brother-in-law.

questions.questionText: Mother's parents are
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The parents of one's mother are designated as maternal grandparents.

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा 'प्रत्यय-रहित' शब्द है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'भावविह्वल' दो स्वतंत्र शब्दों (भाव + विह्वल) के मेल से बना समस्त पद है, इसमें किसी प्रत्यय का प्रयोग नहीं हुआ है।

questions.questionText: भाषा की उपयुक्त परिभाषा है
questions.optionA: विचार या भाव प्रकट करने वाला सार्थक ध्वनिसमूह भाषा कहलाता है
questions.optionB: विचार या भाव को लिपि-चिह्नों में प्रकट करने को भाषा कहते हैं
questions.optionC: विचार या भाव प्रकट करने का साधन भाषा है
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: आधिकारिक उत्तर कुंजी के अनुसार विकल्प (C) सही माना गया है।

questions.questionText: स्वर के कितने प्रकार हैं?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: मुख्य रूप से उत्पत्ति या कालमान के आधार पर स्वर के दो भेद (ह्रस्व और दीर्घ) माने जाते हैं।

questions.questionText: ह्रस्व स्वर कौन-सा है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: मूल या ह्रस्व स्वर अ, इ, उ, ऋ होते हैं। अतः 'अ' ह्रस्व स्वर है।

questions.questionText: उच्चारण के आधार पर व्यंजनों का वर्गीकरण कितने भागों में किया जा सकता है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: प्रयत्न या उच्चारण स्थान के अनुसार व्यंजनों को प्रायः आठ वर्गों में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है।

questions.questionText: 'अल्पप्राण' ध्वनि कौन-सी है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: प्रत्येक वर्ग का पहला, तीसरा और पाँचवाँ वर्ण अल्पप्राण होता है। चवर्ग का प्रथम वर्ण 'च' अल्पप्राण है।

questions.questionText: 'घोष' ध्वनि कौन-सी है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: प्रत्येक वर्ग के तीसरे, चौथे और पाँचवे वर्ण सघोष/घोष होते हैं। ग, ज और ध तीनों घोष ध्वनियाँ हैं।

questions.questionText: स्पर्शी व्यंजन है
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: पवर्ग के वर्ण स्पर्श व्यंजन के अंतर्गत आते हैं, इसलिए एक से अधिक विकल्प सही हैं।

questions.questionText: 'अग्नि' शब्द का विशेषण है
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'अग्नि' संज्ञा शब्द से निर्मित विशेषण रूप 'आग्नेय' होता है।

questions.questionText: प्रकंपी व्यंजन है
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'र' वर्ण के उच्चारण में जिह्वा में कंपन होता है, इसलिए इसे लुंठित या प्रकंपी व्यंजन कहते हैं।

questions.questionText: अर्ध स्वर है
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: हिंदी वर्णमाला में अंतःस्थ व्यंजन 'य' और 'व' दोनों को अर्धस्वर माना जाता है।

questions.questionText: चवर्ग का व्यंजन है
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: चवर्ग में च, छ, ज, झ, ञ आते हैं, अतः एक से अधिक विकल्प चवर्ग के व्यंजन हैं।

questions.questionText: (क) केकी, (ख) विहंग, (ग) खग, (घ) पिक विकल्पों में से कौन-सा युग्म 'पक्षी' के पर्याय का है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'विहंग' और 'खग' पक्षी के पर्यायवाची शब्द हैं; केकी मयूर का तथा पिक कोयल का पर्याय है।

questions.questionText: विलोम शब्द का कौन-सा युग्म सही है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: दिए गए विकल्पों में कोई भी सही विलोम युग्म नहीं है (कापुरुष-कायर और कुत्सा-निंदा समानार्थी हैं)।

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा वाक्य अशुद्ध है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: आधिकारिक उत्तर कुंजी के अनुसार दिए गए सभी वाक्य व्याकरणिक दृष्टि से शुद्ध हैं, अतः 'उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं' सही है।

questions.questionText: रचना के आधार पर कौन-सा विकल्प वाक्य का भेद नहीं है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: रचना के आधार पर वाक्य के तीन भेद होते हैं: सरल, संयुक्त और मिश्र वाक्य। 'उपवाक्य' वाक्य का एक घटक है, भेद नहीं।

questions.questionText: जिन शब्दों से न्यूनता, लघुता, हीनता या तुच्छता का बोध हो, उसे क्या कहते हैं?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: लघुता, हीनता या तुच्छता का भाव प्रकट करने वाले शब्दों को ऊनार्थक (या उनार्थक) शब्द कहा जाता है।

questions.questionText: 'जिसे बुलाया न गया हो' वाक्यांश के लिए प्रयुक्त एक शब्द क्या होगा?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: जिसे आमंत्रित न किया गया हो या जिसे बुलाया न गया हो, उसे 'अनाहूत' कहते हैं।

questions.questionText: संज्ञा की माप-तौल का बोध कराने वाले विशेषण कहलाते हैं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: किसी वस्तु के परिमाण, नाप या तौल का बोध कराने वाले विशेषण को परिमाणवाचक विशेषण कहते हैं।

questions.questionText: रचना के आधार पर 'जल' शब्द किस कोटि का है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: जिन शब्दों के सार्थक खंड न किए जा सकें, वे रूढ़ शब्द कहलाते हैं। 'जल' एक रूढ़ शब्द है।

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा मात्रिक छन्द है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: दोहा और सोरठा दोनों मात्रिक छंद हैं, इसलिए 'उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक' सही है।

questions.questionText:
"उदित उदयगिरि मंच पर रघुवर बाल पतंग।
बिकसे संत सरोज सब हरषे लोचन भृंग।।"
उपर्युक्त दोहे में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: उपमेय पर उपमान का अभेद आरोप होने के कारण यहाँ सांग रूपक अलंकार है।

questions.questionText: The cost of 5 bats and 18 balls is 6,500 and the cost of 2 bats and 20 balls is 4,200. What are the costs of one bat and one ball respectively?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText: A shopkeeper purchases an item at 615 and sells it at 820. What is his percentage profit?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText: A hacker finds that the ATM PIN of a person has first two digits ranging from 3 to 8, and the fourth digit is either 0 or 9. How many attempts must the hacker try in order to decode the PIN?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Digits from 3 to 8 inclusive count 6 possibilities each. First digit: 6 choices; second: 6 choices; third: 10 choices (0-9); fourth: 2 choices (0 or 9). Total attempts = 6 * 6 * 10 * 2 = 720.

questions.questionText: The lengths of two sides of a triangle are 8 cm and 9 cm, and its area is 12*sqrt(5) cm2. What is the length of the third side?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Area = (1/2)*a*b*sin(C) => 12√5 = (1/2)*8*9*sin(C) => sin(C) = √5/3. Then cos(C) can be either 2/3 or -2/3, yielding two valid lengths for the third side (c = 7 cm or c = √177 cm). Hence 'More than one of the above' is correct.

questions.questionText: There are 50 numbers. Each number is subtracted from 53, and the mean of the numbers so obtained is found to be -3.5. The mean of the given numbers is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText: The ratio of the ages of two brothers is 4:3. If the elder brother is 6 years older than the younger one, then their ages (in years) are
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Let ages be 4x and 3x. Then 4x - 3x = 6 => x = 6. The ages are 24 and 18.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: (1/2) * (2/3) * (3/4) * ... * ((n-1)/n) cancels intermediate terms, resulting in 1/n.

questions.questionText: The quadratic equation with roots 1 and 4 is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Equation: (x - 1)(x - 4) = x^2 - 5x + 4 = 0. Since this is not listed in options A, B, or C, 'None of the above' is correct.

questions.questionText: The Sun observation point of Aditya-L1 satellite is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: ISRO's solar observatory Aditya-L1 is stationed in a halo orbit around the Sun-Earth Lagrangian point L1.

questions.questionText: Ginger is an underground stem and not a root because
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Ginger is a modified stem (rhizome) characterized by the presence of nodes, internodes, and scale leaves.

questions.questionText: The focal length of a convex lens is fL = 10 cm. On immersing in water, it will act as a
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: By the lens maker's formula, immersing glass in water decreases the relative refractive index, increasing focal length while remaining convex.

questions.questionText: Though water is transparent to visible light, it is not possible to see distant objects in fog which consists of fine drops of water. This is so because
questions.optionA: fine drops of water are opaque to visible light
questions.optionB: most of the light is scattered to create apparent opacity
questions.optionC: light rays suffer total internal reflection and so unable to reach observer's eyes
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Fog droplets scatter incident light rays in all directions (Mie scattering), obscuring visibility.

questions.questionText: Monochromatic light enters from one medium to the other. Which one of the following properties does not change?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The frequency of a wave is determined solely by the source and remains invariant during refraction across media.

questions.questionText: The speed of an electron in the orbit of the hydrogen atom in the ground state is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In Bohr's model, ground state velocity v1 = α * c, where α is the fine-structure constant (approximately 1/137).

questions.questionText: A blackbody radiates energy at the rate of E watt per metre^2 at a high temperature T K. When the temperature is reduced to T/3 K, the radiant energy (in watt per metre^2) will be
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Stefan-Boltzmann law states E ∝ T^4. When T becomes T/3, E' = E / (3^4) = E / 81.

questions.questionText: The acid which can destroy the colour of acidic KMnO4 is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Citric acid (C6H8O7) acts as a reducing agent and decolorizes acidic potassium permanganate solution.

questions.questionText: Who was the writer of 'Banglar Mati, Banglar Jal', which was originally a protest song against the Partition of Bengal in 1905 by Lord Curzon, and for which the West Bengal Assembly passed a resolution as the new State Anthem recently?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'Banglar Mati, Banglar Jal' was composed by Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore during the anti-partition Swadeshi movement.

questions.questionText: Who is the architect of the new Parliament of India building inaugurated recently?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Dr. Bimal Patel of HCP Design is the chief architect of the new Parliament building and Central Vista project.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following Indian films was screened at the 76th Cannes Film Festival in May 2023?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Both Anurag Kashyap's 'Kennedy' (Midnight Screenings) and Kanu Behl's 'Agra' (Directors' Fortnight) were screened at Cannes 2023.

questions.questionText: Azali Assoumani, who attended the G20 Summit in New Delhi as the current Chairperson of the African Union which has become the newest member of G20, is the President of which country in the African Union?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Azali Assoumani is the President of the island nation Union of the Comoros.

questions.questionText: When is the 'Human Rights Day' celebrated annually?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Human Rights Day is celebrated worldwide on 10th December to commemorate the adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in 1948.

questions.questionText: Who was the founder of 'Indian National Army (INA)'?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Captain Mohan Singh founded the first Indian National Army in Malaya in 1942, before leadership was transferred to Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose.

questions.questionText: 'Tana Bhagat Movement' was related to
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Tana Bhagat Movement (1914) was a tribal reformist and anti-colonial resistance initiated by Jatra Bhagat among the Oraon tribe.

questions.questionText: In which State is 'Raksha Bandhan' celebrated as 'Tree Safety Day'?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Government of Bihar celebrates Raksha Bandhan as Vriksha Suraksha Diwas (Tree Safety Day) under the Jal-Jeevan-Hariyali mission.

questions.questionText: In which of the following states is black soil found?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Black soil (Regur) is found across the Deccan lava trap region, including large parts of Gujarat and Karnataka.

questions.questionText: How many types of species of flora and fauna are there in India?
questions.optionA: 81000 species of fauna and 47000 species of flora
questions.optionB: 70000 species of fauna and 50000 species of flora
questions.optionC: 50000 species of fauna and 40000 species of flora
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Standard NCERT environmental geography data cites India as having approximately 81,000 species of fauna and 47,000 species of flora.

questions.questionText: Minerals are deposited and accumulated in the strata of which of the following rocks?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In sedimentary rocks, minerals occur in beds or stratified layers through deposition, accumulation, and concentration.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a leguminous crop?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Pulses belong to the family Fabaceae (Leguminosae) and help restore soil nitrogen through root nodule bacterial fixation.

questions.questionText: Which two of the following extreme locations are connected by the East-West Corridor?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The East-West Corridor of the Golden Quadrilateral project links Silchar in Assam to Porbandar in Gujarat.

questions.questionText: Stalactite and stalagmite structures are formed by
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Stalactites and stalagmites are depositional karst landforms created by precipitating calcium carbonate in limestone caverns through groundwater action.

questions.questionText: April 22 is celebrated as the
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: International Mother Earth Day is celebrated annually on April 22.

questions.questionText: Topographical map of India is prepared by which organization?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Survey of India, established in 1767 under the Department of Science and Technology, prepares all official national topographical maps.

questions.questionText: Who first described the Revolt of 1857 as the 'First Indian War of Independence'?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Vinayak Damodar Savarkar penned 'The Indian War of Independence 1857' in 1909, describing the revolt as India's first war of independence.

questions.questionText: Which of the following events happened first?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Chronology: Santhal Rebellion occurred in 1855-1856, Birsa Munda's Ulgulan in 1899-1900, and Tana Bhagat Movement in 1914.

questions.questionText: Which revolt is mentioned in Bankim Chandra Chatterjee's novel, Anandamath?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra's patriotic historical novel 'Anandamath' is set during the Sannyasi Rebellion in late 18th-century Bengal.

questions.questionText: When were 'Swadeshi' and 'Boycott' first adopted as forms of struggle in India?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Boycott and Swadeshi resolutions were adopted at the Calcutta Town Hall meeting in 1905 to protest the Partition of Bengal.

questions.questionText: Who was the President of the Indian National Congress at the Gaya Session of 1922?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Deshbandhu Chittaranjan Das presided over the 37th session of the Indian National Congress held at Gaya in December 1922.

questions.questionText: Who led the peasants of Bihar during the Non-Cooperation Movement?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Swami Vidyanand organized and led the tenant farmers and peasants in north Bihar (especially Darbhanga) during 1919-1922.

questions.questionText: Who founded Hindu College at Calcutta in 1817?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: David Hare, along with Raja Ram Mohan Roy and Radhakanta Deb, established Hindu College in Calcutta in 1817.

questions.questionText: Who among the following said that "Congress is to tottering to its fall and one of my great ambitions while in India is to assist it to a peaceful demise"?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Lord Curzon wrote this statement in a letter to the Secretary of State for India in 1900.

questions.questionText: The brain of any computer system is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Central Processing Unit (CPU) executes instructions, controls buses, and serves as the primary computational brain.

questions.questionText: When a key is pressed on keyboard, which standard is used for converting the keystroke into the corresponding bits?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Keyboards typically encode character inputs into standard ASCII binary codes for personal computers.

questions.questionText: What difference do the fifth generation computers have from other generation computers?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Fifth-generation computing leverages parallel ULSI hardware, artificial intelligence, and advanced natural language processing.

questions.questionText: Source code is available to view, modify and redistribute in
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Open-source software licenses grant users rights to inspect, alter, and freely distribute source code.

questions.questionText: Machine language is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Native machine code is hardware-dependent, challenging for programmers to write manually, and prone to syntax errors.

questions.questionText: An assembly language is a/an
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Assembly language is a low-level symbolic representation of machine instructions specific to a CPU architecture.

questions.questionText: A compiler is a translating program which
questions.optionA: translates instruction of a high-level language into machine language
questions.optionB: translates entire source program into machine language program
questions.optionC: It is not involved in program's execution
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Compilers translate high-level source files into machine code as a whole without directly executing the program.

questions.questionText: Which of the following approaches is used by C++?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Object-oriented languages like C++ follow a bottom-up program design approach centered around classes and objects.

questions.questionText: What is virtual inheritance in C++?
questions.optionA: C++ technique to enhance multiple inheritance
questions.optionB: C++ technique to ensure that a private member of the base class can be accessed somehow
questions.optionC: C++ technique to avoid multiple copies of the base class into children/derived class
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Virtual base classes resolve the diamond inheritance problem by ensuring only a single shared instance of a base subobject is inherited.

questions.optionA: The program is not semantically correct
questions.optionB: The program is compiled and executed successfully
questions.optionC: The program is compiled successfully but throws an error during runtime
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The C++ standard defines applying the delete operator to a null pointer as a harmless no-op.

questions.questionText: What is the difference between delete and delete[] in C++?
questions.optionA: Delete is syntactically correct but delete[] is wrong and hence will give an error if used in any case
questions.optionB: Delete is used to delete normal objects whereas delete[] is used to delete pointer objects
questions.optionC: Delete is used to delete single object whereas delete[] is used to delete multiple (array/pointer of) objects
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'delete' deallocates individual dynamically allocated objects, whereas 'delete[]' invokes destructors and releases dynamically allocated arrays.

questions.optionA: Error in C and successful execution in C++
questions.optionB: Error in both C and C++
questions.optionC: Error in C++ and successful execution in C
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'new' is a reserved keyword in C++ but a valid user identifier in standard C.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Binary OR: 10 (1010) | 5 (0101) = 15 (1111). Boolean promotion: true (1) + false (0) = 1. p = 15 + 1 = 16.

questions.questionText: The C++ code which causes abnormal termination/behaviour of a program should be written under _______ block.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Statements that might throw runtime exceptions are enclosed within a 'try' block for monitoring.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Passing aliases of the same variable produces undefined sequence point behavior in C++; the official answer key marks option (E).

questions.questionText: Pick the incorrect statement about inline functions in C++.
questions.optionA: They save overhead of a return call from a function.
questions.optionB: They are generally very large and complicated function.
questions.optionC: These functions are inserted/substituted at the point of call.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Inline functions should be small and simple; compilers reject inlining requests for large, complex, or recursive functions.

questions.questionText: What is abstract class in C++?
questions.optionA: Any class in C++ is an abstract class/Class from which any class is derived
questions.optionB: Class specifically used as a base class with at least one virtual function
questions.optionC: Class specifically used as a base class with at least one pure virtual function
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In C++, a class containing at least one pure virtual function (= 0) is an abstract class that cannot be directly instantiated.

questions.questionText: Which of the following constructors is provided by the C++ compiler if not defined in a class?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: If no user constructors are declared, the C++ compiler automatically synthesizes an implicit parameterless default constructor.

questions.questionText: How do structures and classes in C++ differ?
questions.optionA: In structures, members are private by default whereas in classes, they are public by default
questions.optionB: In structures, members are public by default whereas in classes, they are private by default
questions.optionC: Structures cannot have private members whereas classes can have
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Struct members default to public access, whereas class members default to private access in C++.

questions.questionText: Which of the following features must be supported by any programming language to become a pure object-oriented programming language?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Object-oriented languages require foundational support for encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, and abstraction.

questions.questionText: The programming language that has the ability to create new data types is called
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: An extensible language allows programmers to define new data types and language constructs.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the original creator of the C++ language?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bjarne Stroustrup created C++ (originally 'C with Classes') at Bell Laboratories in 1979.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the correct syntax to read the single character to console in the C++ language?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The proper standard stream methods are 'cin.get(ch)' or 'cin >> ch', so 'None of the above' is correct.

questions.questionText: Which of the following gives the nth element of the Array?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Because C/C++ arrays are 0-indexed, the nth element is accessed at index n - 1.

questions.questionText: How many types of the array are there in the C++ programming language?
questions.optionA: There are three types of arrays
questions.optionB: There are four types of arrays
questions.optionC: There are two types of arrays
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Arrays in C++ are broadly classified into two categories: single-dimensional and multidimensional arrays.

questions.questionText: In C++, for what purpose the "rank()" is used?
questions.optionA: It returns the size of each dimension
questions.optionB: It returns the maximum number of elements that can be stored in the array
questions.optionC: It returns the dimension of the specified array
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In standard template type traits (std::rank), rank returns the number of dimensions of an array type.

questions.questionText: What is the scope of the variable declared in the user-defined function?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Variables declared within a function possess local block scope, accessible only within their enclosing braces {}.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the correct definition of the "is_array();" function in C++?
questions.optionA: It checks that the specified variable is of the array or not
questions.optionB: It checks that the specified array is of single dimension or not
questions.optionC: It checks that the array specified is of multi-dimension or not
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The std::is_array trait identifies whether a given type is an array.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following statements is true about the new and malloc?
I. The 'new' is a type of operator while 'malloc' is a kind of function.
II. The 'new' invokes a constructor, whereas 'malloc' does not invoke the constructor.
III. The 'malloc' returns void pointer and also needed to typecast whereas 'new' returns required pointer.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Statements I, II, and III are all correct technical distinctions between C++ 'new' and C 'malloc'.

questions.questionText: Which of the following can be considered as the members that can be inherited but not accessible in any class?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Private base members are physically part of the derived class subobject layout, but inaccessible to member functions of derived classes.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following statements is completely true?
I. In an object-oriented programming language, all the function calls are resolved at compile-time.
II. In a procedure programming language, all the function calls are resolved at compile-time.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: OOP languages resolve virtual functions dynamically at runtime (late binding), whereas non-polymorphic procedural languages resolve calls statically at compile-time.

questions.questionText: What will happen if in a C++ program, a class has no name?
questions.optionA: It is not even allowed in C++
questions.optionB: It will not have the constructor
questions.optionC: It will not have the destructor
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Anonymous classes are permissible in C++ for declaring unnamed objects, but cannot define constructors or destructors since those require the class name.

questions.questionText: How can one implement the compile-time polymorphism in the C++ programming language?
questions.optionB: By using the concepts of inheritance
questions.optionC: By using both the virtual functions and inheritance
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Compile-time polymorphism is achieved using function/operator overloading and C++ templates.

questions.questionText: Which of the following refers to the wrapping of data and its functionality into a single individual entity?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Encapsulation bundles data attributes and associated methods into a single unit or class.

questions.questionText: Among the following, which statement is correct about the modularity?
questions.optionA: Modularity means hiding the parts of the program.
questions.optionB: Modularity refers to dividing a program into subsequent small modules or independent parts.
questions.optionC: It refers to overloading the program's part.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Modularity decomposes a software system into smaller, discrete, manageable, and interchangeable modules.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not the application of the stack data structure?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Asynchronous data transfer relies on FIFO queues or ring buffers, not LIFO stacks.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the prefix form of A+B*C?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Operator precedence evaluates B*C first to *BC, and adding A gives +A*BC.

questions.questionText: Which data structure is required to convert the infix to prefix notation?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Parsing expressions and managing operator precedence during notation conversion requires a stack.

questions.questionText: Which of the following highly uses the concept of an array?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Arrays store elements in contiguous memory locations, maximizing CPU cache spatial locality of reference.

questions.questionText: The necessary condition to be checked before deletion from the queue is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Before dequeueing an item, the queue must be checked for an empty/underflow condition.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not the application of the queue data structure?
questions.optionB: Resource is shared between various systems
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Balancing parentheses and matching symbols in compiler design is performed using a stack, not a queue.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following techniques is not used in the binary tree?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Preorder, inorder, and postorder traversals are all standard binary tree traversal algorithms; hence 'None of the above' is correct.

questions.questionText: How can we describe an array in the best possible way?
questions.optionB: Container that stores the elements of similar types
questions.optionC: The array is not a data structure
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: An array is a linear data structure storing fixed-size homogeneous elements in contiguous memory.

questions.questionText: What is another name for the circular queue among the following options?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Circular queues wrap memory pointers conceptually from end to start, commonly referred to as ring buffers.

questions.questionText: Which of the following determines the need for the circular queue?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Circular queues reuse vacated front memory slots created after deletions, preventing the false overflow and memory wastage of linear array queues.

questions.questionText: Which data structure is the best for implementing a priority queue?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A binary heap provides O(log n) insertions and extractions, making it the most efficient structure for priority queues.

questions.questionText: Which of the following data structures finds its use in recursion?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The call stack manages activation frames and variable states during recursive function calls.

questions.questionText: Which of the following satisfies the property of the red-black tree?
questions.optionA: Black, if the new node is a root node
questions.optionB: Red, if the new node is not a root node
questions.optionC: Black, if the new node is not a root node
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In a red-black tree, the root must be black, and newly inserted nodes start as red, making more than one statement applicable.

questions.questionText: In the deque implementation, using singly linked list, what would be the time complexity of deleting an element from the rear end?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Deleting from the tail of a singly linked list requires traversing from the head to find the node immediately preceding the rear, which takes O(N) time.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the overflow condition if linear queue is implemented using an array with a size MAX_SIZE?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In a 0-indexed linear array queue, the queue is full when the rear index reaches MAX_SIZE - 1.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a divide-and-conquer algorithm?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Merge sort recursively divides the input array into halves, sorts them, and merges the sorted subarrays.

questions.questionText: What is a database?
questions.optionA: Organized collection of information that cannot be accessed, updated and managed
questions.optionB: Organized collection of data or information that can be accessed, updated and managed
questions.optionC: Organized collection of data that cannot be updated
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A database is a systematic, organized repository of structured data that allows controlled storage, retrieval, and updating.

questions.questionText: Which type of data can be stored in the database?
questions.optionC: Data in the form of audio or video
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Modern databases store text, numeric fields, documents, and BLOB binary media files (images, audio, video).

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a type of database?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Hierarchical, network, relational, and distributed systems are standard database models; 'decentralized' is an architecture type rather than a classic database model.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not an example of DBMS?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Google is an Internet search engine and technology corporation, while MS Access and IBM Db2 are database management systems.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a feature of DBMS?
questions.optionA: Minimum duplication and redundancy of data
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Modern DBMS systems support concurrent multi-user transactions; restricting access to a single user is not a defining characteristic.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a function of the database?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Code analysis is performed by static code analyzers and compilers, not by database engines.

questions.questionText: What is information about data called?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Metadata is formally defined as data that provides information about other data.

questions.questionText: The DBMS acts as an interface between _______ and _______ of an enterprise-class system.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A DBMS serves as an intermediary software interface bridging database applications with the underlying physical database files.

questions.questionText: _______ is a set of one or more attribute(s) taken collectively to uniquely identify a record.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A superkey is any set of one or more attributes that collectively identify a unique tuple within a relation.

questions.questionText: Which of the following commands is correct to delete the values in the relation teaches?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'DELETE FROM teaches;' deletes all records/rows from the relation while preserving its table schema.

questions.questionText: The top level of the hierarchy consists of _______ each of can contain _______
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In standard SQL database architectures, environments contain catalogs, and catalogs contain schemas.

questions.questionText: The user IDs can be added or removed using which of the following fixed roles?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In SQL Server database role management, the 'db_accessadmin' role manages access permissions and adds or removes user IDs.

questions.questionText: The traditional storage of data organized by the customer, stored in separate folders in filing cabinets is an example of
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Paper folders in filing cabinets illustrate traditional manual file processing systems, not electronic DBMS models.

questions.questionText: After groups have been established, SQL applies predicates in the _______ clause, allowing aggregate functions to be used.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The HAVING clause specifies filtering conditions on grouped summary data after GROUP BY execution.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is not the utility of DBMS?
I. Backup
II. Loading
III. Process organization
IV. File organization
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Designated option (C) as per the official answer key.

questions.questionText: For designing a normal RDBMS, which of the following normal forms is considered adequate?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Third Normal Form (3NF) balances the elimination of update anomalies with join efficiency, making it the practical industry standard for relational design.

questions.questionText: What happens if a piece of data is stored in two places in the db?
questions.optionA: Storage space is wasted and changing the data in one spot will cause data inconsistency
questions.optionB: Changing the data in one spot will cause data inconsistency
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Data redundancy wastes storage and risks data inconsistency when updates are applied to one copy but not the other.

questions.questionText: Which data type can store unstructured data in a column?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In Oracle SQL, the RAW and BLOB data types store binary, unstructured byte streams.

questions.questionText: The logic gate that provides high output for same input is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The X-NOR (equivalence gate) produces an output of 1 when all its inputs are identical (00 or 11).

questions.questionText: Boolean algebra can be used
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Boolean algebra is fundamental to digital computer architecture, circuit minimization, and switching theory.

questions.questionText: Communication between a computer and a keyboard involves _______ transmission.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Data flows strictly unidirectionally from the keyboard to the computer, which is a simplex transmission mode.

questions.questionText: The simplified form of the Boolean expression (X+Y+XY)(X+Z) is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: X + Y + XY simplifies to X + Y. Then (X + Y)(X + Z) simplifies by the distributive law to X + YZ. Because option (B) is X+YZ, official answer key marks option (E).

questions.questionText: The dual of a Boolean expression is obtained by
questions.optionB: interchanging all 0s and 1s, all + and '.' signs
questions.optionC: interchanging all 0s and 1s, all + and '.' signs and complementing all the variables
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The principle of duality states that an expression's dual is formed by swapping AND (.) with OR (+) operators and 0 with 1 without complementing variables.

questions.questionText: Wireless transmission of signals can be done via
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Unguided wireless communication utilizes radio frequencies, microwave links, and line-of-sight infrared beams.

questions.questionText: Sniffers can be prevented by using
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Switches forward unicast frames only to the designated destination port, preventing promiscuous packet sniffing seen on shared hubs.

questions.questionText: In TDM, slots are further divided into
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In Time-Division Multiplexing (TDM), frames are divided into time slots (not slots into frames), making 'None of the above' correct.

questions.questionText: Transmission control protocol
questions.optionB: uses a three-way handshake to establish a connection
questions.optionC: receives data from application as a single stream
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: TCP is a connection-oriented, byte-stream protocol that uses a three-way handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK) for connection setup.

questions.questionText: An endpoint of an inter-process communication flow across a computer network is called
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A socket represents an operational communication endpoint bound to an IP address and port number.

questions.questionText: Which transmission media provides the highest transmission speed in a network?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Fiber-optic cables transmit light pulses with high bandwidth and minimal attenuation, providing the fastest data transmission speeds.
